title: Compounds
textbookText: Amide Functional group –OH General formula CnH(2n+1)OH General representation: ROH IUPAC name: Alkane-e+ol= Alkanol Note: select the longest chain containing –OH group as parent chain and counting of carbon is done from the nearest terminal of the –OH group. The position of –OH group is indicated by Arabic numerals before the suffix –ol. If two or three –OH groups are present in the same molecule diol or triol is written along with their position. Example:
IUPAC name: Alkane-e+oyl halide = Alkanoyl halide
IUPAC Name Methanoyl chloride Ethanoyl chloride Propanoyl chloride
